overview: Personalized suggestions use what shoppers do on your store, so consent matters. We update the wording of your cookie banner and the recommendation lines in your privacy page so they are clear. We are not lawyers, so we give you a checklist to review with your adviser.

faq: No. We are a web and marketing studio, not a law firm. We set your store to respect the choices shoppers make, and we give you a checklist for your own adviser to confirm.
What happens if a shopper declines cookies?
They still see products, but suggestions fall back to non personal rules, such as best sellers or the same collection. We test this so the store looks complete either way.
We build to common patterns used under rules such as GDPR and CCPA, and set regions as you request. Requirements differ by country, so your adviser should confirm what applies to your business.
Do you change my cookie banner app?
We can adjust its settings and text if you give us staff access. If you do not have a banner, we recommend a suitable one and set it up, and you pay for any paid plan.
